name: Construction Hard Hat
flavor: Borrowed from a job site in 2003.

name: Dad Cap
flavor: Faded logo. High perception bonus from years of suspicious squinting.

name: Chest Pad (Catcher's)
flavor: From youth baseball. Still fits. Barely.

name: Fleece Vest
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 Dadism power. Multiple pockets. One function.

name: Work Gloves
flavor: Grip improved. Knuckles protected. Confidence irrelevant.

name: Tape Measure (Belt Clip)
flavor: +1 PER. Always visible. Never used correctly.

name: Cargo Shorts
flavor: +2 inventory slots. Standard issue Dad equipment.

name: Khaki Dad Pants
flavor: +1 Dadism power. Pleated. Ironed. Non-negotiable.

name: Tube Socks (Pulled Up)
flavor: +1 DEF. They come up to the knee. He is aware.

name: Steel-Toe Boots
flavor: +2 DEF, +1 ATK. Safety certified. Impact tested on a Wednesday.

name: Wraparound Sunglasses
flavor: +2 PER. He can see everything. He is judging everything. SPF: unlimited.

name: Hearing Protection Muffs
flavor: Blocks sound. Deepens wisdom through selective deafness.

name: Dad Bandana (Forehead)
flavor: +1 ATK. He means business. The business is unclear.

name: High-Vis Safety Vest
flavor: Seen from space. Enemies see him coming and somehow still lose.

name: Denim Shirt (Buttoned Wrong)
flavor: +DEF, +WIS. The top button is incorrect. He knows. He stays the course.

name: Windbreaker (Circa 2001)
flavor: Makes a sound with every movement. Enemies hear him approach. Somehow still effective.

name: Grilling Apron
flavor: +DEF, +ATK. 'Kiss the Cook.' Nobody is kissing the cook. He presses on.

name: Knee Brace (Right Knee)
flavor: +2 DEF. Braced. Reinforced. The right knee will outlast the man who wears it. The left knee is on its own.

name: Elastic-Waist Sweatpants
flavor: +1 slot, +1 Dadism power. Comfort is a tactical advantage.

name: Relaxed-Fit Jeans
flavor: Relaxed fit. Dad approved. Structurally sound at exactly one wash temperature.

name: Sandals with Socks
flavor: Maximum comfort. Minimum dignity. He has made his peace.

name: Garage Flip-Flops
flavor: +1 PER. Slaps on every surface. The sound announces him. His enemies prepare. Somehow still.

name: Work Boots (Broken-In)
flavor: +3 DEF. 20 years of wear. Resoled twice. His sons will inherit them.

name: Rubber Dishwashing Gloves
flavor: +2 DEF. Waterproof. Designed for dishes. Repurposed for combat.

name: Utility Belt (Dad-Configured)
flavor: +2 slots, +1 PER. Contains one of everything needed for almost any situation. Weight: heroic.

name: Compression Knee Sleeves
flavor: +1 DEF. While worn, the knees do not crack and do not buckle. He bought them for 'working out.' He wears them on stairs.

name: Safety Glasses (Scratched)
flavor: +1 PER. Mandatory eye protection. Worn on the forehead 90% of the time. "You can't hear boobies." Wise advice from countless dads before.

name: Winter Beanie (Worn Indoors)
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 Dadism power. The thermostat is at 64. He has made his choice. The beanie is the consequence and the comfort.

name: Lumberjack Flannel (Unbuttoned)
flavor: +2 DEF, +1 ATK. He has never felled a tree. The flannel does not know this. The flannel believes in him.

name: Elbow Pads (Just In Case)
flavor: +2 DEF. Purchased for a hobby that never started. Deployed for a war that never ended.

name: Painter's Overalls (Three Projects Old)
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 slot. Every stain is a memory. Every pocket holds a forgotten brush. Structurally: mostly dried paint.

name: Crocs (Sport Mode Engaged)
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 PER. The strap is back. He means business. The ventilation is a tactical liability he accepts.

name: Emergency Rain Poncho (From the Glovebox)
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 PER. Folded since the 2018 game that got rained out. Smells of the glovebox. Deploys with a defiant crinkle.
